integrity: Analytical proof with exact endpoint signs and convexity/concavity thresholds. Exact-rational standalone checker verifies a nontrivial four-root witness and one fixed-point-free witness; finite checks are not asserted to certify every real parameter.
scientific_limitations: Fixed points and their local stability only for \(0<a,b,c<1\) and \(0<d<1\); does not classify periodic orbits of higher periods, attractors, chaos, entropy, or boundary parameters. A relevant 2024 follow-up was checked at abstract and bibliography level only because full text was not accessible; residual priority risk is explicitly disclosed.
title: Complete fractional-power fixed-point phase diagram for a discontinuous interval family
